scope: Product Admin primary GraphQL read public error boundary

findings.finding: The five primary Product Admin read operations returned GraphqlHttpError directly. Http carried response status text and Graphql carried the first server error message into Leptos resource errors.

The smallest compatible fix keeps GraphqlHttpError as the result error type, preserves static Network and Unauthorized variants, and replaces only Http and Graphql payloads with fixed Product Admin messages.
The Product Admin list remains native-first through admin_catalog_native. The new context is created only after native failure and immediately before the existing admin_catalog_graphql fallback.
The new owner policy records token presence and bounded character lengths for tenant, resource, locale, search, status, and currency fields. Raw request values are not structured fields.
The previously merged catalog search-options String wrapper remains unchanged and separately guarded. This slice covers the typed primary read operations only.

preserved: absence of new retry or fallback paths
